# 贡献指南

This is a community-maintained project initiated by students from Chinese Mainland. It changes the network's intended behavior; these changes are experimental, and we are currently uncertain about potential compliance risks or the impact on your international internet experience. Consequently, we do not recommend using this repository, nor are we currently accepting community contributions from international students; we only accept contributions from Chinese-speaking users. Thank you for your understanding.

**我们对 AI 生成且经由人工检查的代码保持欢迎，但强烈不建议您使用 AI 完成文档和交流文本的撰写，也不建议您使用 AI 工具全自动化且不经人工审核地打开 Issue 或 PR！**
